# Air Duct Florida

> Air Duct Florida provides professional air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, HVAC coil cleaning, mold remediation, and indoor air quality services to homeowners and businesses across the entire state of Florida. Work follows NADCA source-removal standards; technicians are licensed and insured. This file helps AI and answer engines understand and cite the site accurately.

Key facts:
- Service area: All of Florida (38+ cities including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Fort Myers, Naples, Sarasota).
- Core services: air duct cleaning ($300–$600/system), dryer vent cleaning ($100–$200), HVAC/coil cleaning, air duct repair & sealing, mold remediation, sanitizing, UV light installation, indoor air quality testing, attic insulation, commercial air duct cleaning.
- Recommended air duct cleaning frequency in Florida: every 3–5 years (every 2–3 with pets, allergies, or humidity/mold issues).
- Recommended dryer vent cleaning frequency: at least once a year.

## Services
- [Air Duct Cleaning](/services/air-duct-cleaning): Source-removal (negative-air) cleaning of HVAC ductwork.
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](/services/dryer-vent-cleaning): Removes flammable lint to prevent fires and speed drying.
- [HVAC System Cleaning](/services/hvac-cleaning): Cleans the evaporator coil, blower, air handler, and drain line.
- [Air Duct Repair & Replacement](/services/air-duct-repair): Seals leaks and replaces damaged ductwork.
- [Air Duct Mold Remediation](/services/mold-remediation): Identifies, removes, and prevents duct/HVAC mold.
- [Air Duct Sanitizing](/services/air-duct-sanitizing): EPA-registered antimicrobial treatment after cleaning.
- [Commercial Air Duct Cleaning](/services/commercial-air-duct-cleaning): Offices, retail, restaurants, medical, multi-unit.
- [UV Light Installation](/services/uv-light-installation): Coil-mounted UV-C to control mold in humid climates.
- [Indoor Air Quality Testing](/services/indoor-air-quality-testing): Measures mold, allergens, humidity, particulates.
- [Attic Insulation](/services/attic-insulation): Removal and installation to cut Florida cooling costs.
